anatomy.source: Measured actual native triangle-plane cross sections after uniform native-to-root transform; brown/gray texture-supported lower woody loops, upper canopy excluded
anatomy.terminalNote: Native main limb forks near x0.75. Lower terminal path tapers to fine connected twigs by x0.94–0.98; preserve those vertices in Lite rather than inflate or collapse them.
